run_pulsar_sphere_renderer: run the pulsar sphere renderer to render 10 random spheres and save the output image
create_pointclouds_with_positions: create a Pointclouds object with random 3D positions and RGB color features on GPU
build_perspective_cameras: build a PerspectiveCameras object with a custom focal length, rotation, and translation matrix
render_spheres_with_pulsar: render spheres using PulsarPointsRenderer with configurable gamma blending, znear, and zfar parameters
save_rendered_image: save the rendered PyTorch3D image tensor to a PNG file using imageio
